grammar.q: The bridge that connects the island to the mainland, which thousands of commuters cross daily, [ ____ ] by a famous Korean engineer to withstand powerful typhoons.
Loud noise from ships passing through the narrow strait [ ____ ] whales that use sound to communicate with each other.
Several unexpected technical problems [ ____ ] during the final test of the new weather satellite.
The historic building in the city center [ ____ ] by a team of experts who specialize in traditional architecture.
Most of the listeners were [ ____ ] by the speaker, who kept checking his phone during his own presentation.
Every employee at the factory was made [ ____ ] a helmet and safety glasses after the accident in the cargo area.
The rare ceramics that the museum bought from a private collector last year [ ____ ] in a room where the temperature is carefully controlled.
The members of the debate club, who had practiced for weeks, [ ____ ] a strong argument against the new school policy.
Fossils of a dinosaur species unknown to science [ ____ ] by students on a field trip.
All applications for the summer exchange program [ ____ ] online before the end of this month.
Any damage to the books borrowed from the library [ ____ ] by the borrower before the semester ends.
The private correspondence between the two scientists during the war [ ____ ] in a box hidden under the floor of an old house that was about to be demolished.
The question of how to allocate the budget for reducing food waste, which the council raised last month, [ ____ ] at several public meetings.
Many traditional customs that were once common in rural communities [ ____ ] as young people moved to cities.
The children looked [ ____ ] about the chance to help the famous scientist on the stage.
Special sensors placed along the coast are used [ ____ ] small changes in sea level caused by underwater earthquakes.

The valuable paintings stored in the basement of the national gallery [ ____ ] by water when a pipe burst during the winter.
The new method for purifying water that a team of high school students developed [ ____ ] by engineers working on sanitation projects in villages around the world.
A huge wind farm that will supply electricity to over ten thousand homes [ ____ ] off the southern coast with a subsidy from the national government.
Dozens of houses near the reservoir [ ____ ] when the heavy rain caused the old dam to collapse last summer.
Several of the fragile ornaments that the archaeologists uncovered in the ancient tomb [ ____ ] by experts at the national museum right now.
The causes of the fire that destroyed the historic market last winter [ ____ ] by the police, who suspect that hazardous chemicals were stored there.
A violent storm that had formed over the ocean [ ____ ] the coastal city late at night, knocking out power to thousands of homes.
The jury for this year’s international photography contest [ ____ ] seven professional photographers from five different countries.
The ancient city, in which merchants from three continents had traded for centuries, [ ____ ] mysteriously around the year 900.
Stray animals found on the streets of the city [ ____ ] by volunteers until new owners adopt them.
The outdoor concert planned for Saturday evening [ ____ ] until next month because of the forecast of heavy rain.
The fans were deeply [ ____ ] by the band’s sudden decision to cancel the concert only an hour before it began.
The two-hour lecture on economic theory was so [ ____ ] that many students in the back row fell asleep before the professor even reached the main point.
Exhausted after the long climb, the hikers were [ ____ ] to see the lights of the mountain lodge.
The late writer is said [ ____ ] most of his twenties traveling alone across South America.
It [ ____ ] that eating breakfast regularly helps students concentrate better during morning classes.
The two boys were seen [ ____ ] over the school fence by a security guard shortly before the window of the science lab was broken.
During the compulsory training camp, the young swimmers were made [ ____ ] for six hours a day without a single day off.
Workers who move to the night shift often find it hard to get used to [ ____ ] during the day.
Waste heat from the factory is used [ ____ ] the greenhouses in which vegetables are grown.
My grandmother, who grew up on a farm, used to [ ____ ] up before sunrise to feed the animals.
The volunteers [ ____ ] by the Red Cross last year were sent to help the flood victims.
The scientists [ ____ ] to the international conference presented their research on renewable energy to an audience of policymakers and representatives from thirty countries.
Nearly half of the food donated to the shelter during the holidays [ ____ ] to displaced families who had lost their homes.

arrange.ko: 도심에 서 있는 그 낡은 시계탑은 약 200년 전에 한 이름 없는 건축가에 의해 설계되었다.
arrange.bogi: was designed / standing in the city center / by an unknown architect about 200 years ago / the old clock tower
arrange.ans: The old clock tower standing in the city center was designed by an unknown architect about 200 years ago.

arrange.ko: 그 나이 든 의사는 30년 넘게 무료로 환자들을 치료해 왔기 때문에 마을 사람들에게 존경받는다.
arrange.bogi: the old doctor / by the villagers because he has treated patients for free for over thirty years / be looked up to
arrange.ans: The old doctor is looked up to by the villagers because he has treated patients for free for over thirty years.

arrange.ko: 도로가 폭설로 막혔기 때문에, 그 행사는 다음 주 토요일로 연기되었다.
arrange.bogi: was put off / as the roads were blocked by heavy snow, / until next Saturday / the event
arrange.ans: As the roads were blocked by heavy snow, the event was put off until next Saturday.

arrange.ko: 박물관을 방문한 학생들은 가이드에게 그 오래된 성이 언제, 누구에 의해 지어졌는지 물었다.
arrange.bogi: when and by whom / the students visiting the museum / the old castle was built / asked the guide
arrange.ans: The students visiting the museum asked the guide when and by whom the old castle was built.

arrange.ko: 구조대가 도착했을 무렵, 그 등산객들은 이미 이틀 동안 산에서 길을 잃은 상태였다.
arrange.bogi: in the mountains for two days / the hikers / by the time the rescue team arrived, / had already been lost
arrange.ans: By the time the rescue team arrived, the hikers had already been lost in the mountains for two days.

arrange.ko: 결선에 오른 참가자들은 시상식에서 자신의 작품을 발표하도록 요청받을 것이다.
arrange.bogi: to present their work at the award ceremony / who reach the final round / will be asked / the participants
arrange.ans: The participants who reach the final round will be asked to present their work at the award ceremony.

arrange.ko: 인쇄 업체로부터 답변을 받으면, 소책자의 예산과 일정이 더 효과적으로 정해질 것이다.
arrange.bogi: the budget and schedule for the brochure / be received from the printing company, / will be set more effectively / once a reply
arrange.ans: Once a reply is received from the printing company, the budget and schedule for the brochure will be set more effectively.

arrange.ko: 내가 늦게 도착했기 때문에, 오디션에서 우승한 그 밴드의 부원들은 나에게 장난을 치기로 결정했다.
arrange.bogi: decide / that had won the audition / since I arrived late, / to play a joke on me / the members of the band
arrange.ans: Since I arrived late, the members of the band that had won the audition decided to play a joke on me.

arrange.ko: 지난여름 홍수로 피해를 입은 그 다리는 다음 달 말까지 다시 지어질 것이다.
arrange.bogi: will be rebuilt by the end of next month / the bridge that / be damaged by the flood last summer
arrange.ans: The bridge that was damaged by the flood last summer will be rebuilt by the end of next month.

arrange.ko: 나는 우리 밴드가 오디션의 우승자로 뽑혔다는 것을 듣고 기쁨으로 가득 찼다.
arrange.bogi: to hear that our band had been / I / choose as the winner of the audition / was filled with joy
arrange.ans: I was filled with joy to hear that our band had been chosen as the winner of the audition.

translate.en: As we wish to update the overall design of our brochure, we are considering working with a new printing company. 우리가 소책자의 전반적인 디자인을 새롭게 하기를 원하므로, 새로운 인쇄 업체와 함께 일하는 것을 고려하고 있다.
translate.ko: 이번 주에 주 다리가 수리되고 있으므로, 운전자들은 도시 동쪽의 터널을 이용하도록 권고받는다.

translate.en: Before proceeding, we would like to ask you how much it would cost. 진행하기에 앞서, 비용이 얼마나 들지 여쭙고 싶습니다.
translate.ko: 신입생들은 사서에게 모둠 과제를 위해 빌린 책을 얼마나 오래 가지고 있어도 되는지 물었다.

translate.en: I had truly believed we would make it; our audition had been flawless. 나는 우리가 해낼 거라고 정말로 믿었었다. 우리의 오디션은 흠잡을 데가 없었다.
translate.ko: 소방관들이 도착했을 무렵, 불은 이미 그 오래된 목조 건물의 2층까지 번져 있었다.

translate.en: Frederick Law Olmsted, known as the father of American landscape architecture, was born in 1822. 미국 조경 건축의 아버지로 알려진 Frederick Law Olmsted는 1822년에 태어났다.
translate.ko: 남해안에서 약 50킬로미터 떨어진 곳에 있는 그 작은 섬에는 200종이 넘는 새가 산다.

translate.en: [Day 3] Open Studio: Friends and family are invited to see what participants have created! [3일 차] Open Studio: 친구와 가족이 참가자들이 창작한 것을 보도록 초대됩니다!
translate.ko: 시험을 일찍 끝낸 학생들은 종이 울릴 때까지 교실을 떠나는 것이 허락되지 않는다.

translate.en: I ran into the music room, breathing heavily.
translate.ko: 나는 숨을 가쁘게 쉬며 음악실로 뛰어 들어갔다.

translate.en: The rest of the band were sitting with long faces.
translate.ko: 밴드의 나머지 부원들은 시무룩한 얼굴로 앉아 있었다.

translate.en: Immy looked up at me and shook her head. I sank into a chair.
translate.ko: Immy는 나를 올려다보며 고개를 가로저었다. 나는 의자에 털썩 주저앉았다.

translate.en: I had truly believed we would make it; our audition had been flawless.
translate.ko: 나는 우리가 해낼 거라고 정말로 믿었었다. 우리의 오디션은 흠잡을 데가 없었다.

translate.en: My chest felt heavy as I asked, “So, who won?” I was holding back my tears.
translate.ko: “그래서, 누가 우승했어?”라고 물을 때 내 가슴은 무거웠다. 나는 눈물을 참고 있었다.

translate.en: “A band called A Happy Accident. They were quite good,” she said calmly.
translate.ko: “A Happy Accident라는 밴드야. 그들 꽤 잘하더라.”라고 그녀가 차분하게 말했다.

translate.en: A moment later, a big smile spread across Immy’s face, and the others began to cheer.
translate.ko: 잠시 후 Immy의 얼굴에 환한 미소가 번졌고, 다른 부원들이 환호하기 시작했다.

translate.en: Immy laughed and said, “Since you were late, we decided to play a joke on you! We made it!”
translate.ko: Immy가 웃으며 말했다. “네가 늦어서 우리가 장난을 좀 치기로 했지! 우리가 해냈어!”

translate.en: I was filled with joy. We jumped up and hugged each other.
translate.ko: 나는 기쁨으로 가득 찼다. 우리는 벌떡 일어나 서로를 껴안았다.
